name: Senpai! Suki nan desu!
original_name: センパイ！すきなんです！
source:
"I've liked you for a long time now! Please, go out with me!"

This kind of confession happens only once in a lifetime. I mustered the courage to reveal my feelings, but I was shot down right away.

"April Fools' Day or not, you can't joke about things like that."

Did I not get through to him?! What am I going to do now?!

[Translated from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/17382]Freem![/url]]
translation:
“我喜欢你很久了！求求你，跟我出去吧！”

这样的告白一生只发生一次。我鼓起勇气表露自己的感情，但马上就被击落了。

“无论愚人节与否，你都不能开这样的玩笑。”

难道我没有联系到他吗？！我现在该怎么办？！

[译自[url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/17382]Freem![/url]]
